title: bidens asperata
intro: Bidens asperata, commonly known as Asperata or Rough-seed Bidens, is a flowering plant native to tropical Asia, belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Bidens asperata are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects, as well as its ability to regulate blood sugar levels and improve liver function. The bioactive constituents of Bidens asperata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential to treat various diseases.
